description: KNa₂WN₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pca2₁ space group. There are two inequivalent K sites. In the first K site, K is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to four N atoms. There are a spread of K-N bond distances ranging from 2.73-2.81 Å. In the second K site, K is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four N atoms. There are a spread of K-N bond distances ranging from 2.97-3.11 Å. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to five N atoms. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.49-3.05 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to four N atoms to form distorted NaN₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four WN₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent NaN₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.54 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to four N atoms to form distorted NaN₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four WN₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent NaN₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.47 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four N atoms. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.50-2.62 Å. There are two inequivalent W sites. In the first W site, W is bonded to four N atoms to form WN₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent WN₄ tetrahedra and corners with four NaN₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (1.83 Å) and two longer (1.96 Å) W-N bond lengths. In the second W site, W is bonded to four N atoms to form WN₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent WN₄ tetrahedra and corners with four NaN₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (1.84 Å) and two longer (1.95 Å) W-N bond lengths. There are six inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one K, two Na, and two W atoms. In the second N site, N is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one K, two Na, and two W atoms. In the third N site, N is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two K, three Na, and one W atom. In the fourth N site, N is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one K, three Na, and one W atom. In the fifth N site, N is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to two K, four Na, and one W atom. In the sixth N site, N is bonded in a distorted trigonal bipyramidal geometry to one K, three Na, and one W atom.
